mathematical_contract.sse: S = sum over scored rows of e_t(b)^2; A = sum e_t*de_t; B = sum (de_t*de_t' + e_t*d2e_t).
mathematical_contract.nuisance: v_hat = S/n_eff for S>0; explicit VarianceEstimate, never an input/free derivative axis.
mathematical_contract.profile_value: P(b) = n_eff/2 * (log(2*pi) + 1 + log(S/n_eff)); additive, no averaging or dropped constants.
mathematical_contract.profile_hessian: H = n_eff*B/S - 2*n_eff*A*A'/S^2; equals H_bb - H_bv*H_vv^-1*H_vb at v_hat.
mathematical_contract.profile_target: All remaining mean parameters, dense K*K Hessian; K excludes variance. Statistical model count remains K+1.
mathematical_contract.chart: Shared AR reflection map, negative-sign MA reflection map, identity linear coefficients. g_z=J'*g and H_z=J'*H*J+sum_i g_i*d2theta_i(z), retaining original z.
mathematical_contract.zero_sse: No finite positive-variance MLE; infimum NLL=-infinity as v approaches zero. mathematical_domain plus zero_sse_unbounded, no valid F/G/H, no synthetic finite penalty.
mathematical_contract.floating_support: SSE and reconstructed variance must be positive finite binary64. Nonzero residuals whose squares all underflow are numerical_range, not exact zero. Overflow/range loss is rejected, not floored/clipped.
mathematical_contract.subnormal_log: Subnormal nuisance values use log(S)-log(n_eff) in F to avoid log of a rounded subnormal quotient. The returned variance is the binary64 quotient; rescoring that rounded nuisance as a full joint point can differ near the smallest subnormal values.

sample_contract.conditioning: Explicit recursion_begin independent of first_scored; absent uses shared mean default. Zero innovations/sensitivities before recursion_begin; conditional AR lags use retained observations.
sample_contract.scoring: One contiguous retained suffix [first_scored,n); earlier recursion rows advance state and sensitivities but contribute no SSE. n_eff=n-first_scored.
sample_contract.external_histories: Supplied observation/innovation histories or variance seeds return unsupported_operation under current shared mean contract.
sample_contract.linear_design: External row-major features and optional virtual intercept. Prepared ARX/HARX designs are accepted; lag/HAR design construction and provenance are not implemented here.
sample_contract.units: No internal rescaling; prepared observations/design are interpreted in supplied units.
